The system follows a three-layer architecture:
- **Presentation layer**: the members web portal, to book, pay and cancel bookings, and the reception application, to check the bookings and generate reports. - **Business logic layer**: the booking, members and reports services, which implement the use cases and the business rules. - **Persistence layer**: a data repository on PostgreSQL.
The members service uses Cl@ve to identify the members and the booking service uses the municipal payment platform to collect the bookings.
